answer: Ephemeral challenge mirror.** Each agent receives a rotating challenge derived from its recent audit trail; peers verify answers against a shared beacon so a clone must replay the identical history to pass. A mismatch flags the identity as an island, isolating it from settlement until resolved. Honest agents pay only compute time. An attacker pays full replica upkeep per clone—storage, latency, and audit reconstruction—making each forgery cost nearly what running a genuine agent costs.
